reference_sql:
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur > (
    SELECT AVG(cp.price_eur)
    FROM competitor_prices cp
    WHERE cp.product_id = ph.product_id
  )
alternatives:
WITH check_avg AS (
  -- one row per checked product
  SELECT product_id, AVG(price_eur) AS avg_check_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN check_avg a ON a.product_id = ph.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur > a.avg_check_eur

other_way.sql:
WITH check_avg AS (
  -- one row per checked product
  SELECT product_id, AVG(price_eur) AS avg_check_eur
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN check_avg a ON a.product_id = ph.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur > a.avg_check_eur
other_way.tradeoff: A step with one average per checked product, joined to the current prices, drops unchecked products through the join.
